content.title: Yext CEO offers to take company private in $1.1 billion deal
content.summary: Walrath, who owns 2.8% of the company's shares according to data compiled by LSEG, offered $9.00 per share in cash for the stock he does not already own — a premium of 11.2% to Friday's closing price.  Walrath indicated that the proposal is backed by reputable and well-capitalized financing sources, the company said.  Yext's board has formed a special committee to evaluate the proposal and any strategic alternatives.
